messages:
marta_s: Quick Q — auditor asked for evidence linking the June 2 RBAC change to the incident timeline. We have k8s audit logs, KMS envelope metadata, and S3 object events. What does the auditor accept as a minimal manifest? @auditor_jane

raj_patel: We usually produce a manifest with: incident_id, artifact_path (s3://...), sha256, collected_by, timestamp, and control mapping (SOC2/ISO control IDs). Also include an RBAC diff file (before/after) and a short chain-of-custody note.

auditor_jane: That sounds good. A few specifics: presigned URLs are fine for delivery (time-limited & single-use preferred). We need request IDs and timestamps for KMS ops rather than full plaintext payloads. The RBAC diff should show commit SHAs and ideally the CI run that applied it.

sam_eng: We can package this automatically. Example manifest snippet we plan to include:

````
incident_id: INC-2026-0615
artifacts:
  - path: s3://evidence/INC-2026-0615/k8s-audit.log.gz
    sha256: 3b7a...
    collected_by: marta_s
    collected_at: 2026-06-15T14:02:03Z
rbac_delta: s3://evidence/INC-2026-0615/rbac-delta.patch
rbac_commit: 9f1c2d3
control_map: [SOC2-CC6, ISO27001-A.9]
redaction_map: s3://evidence/INC-2026-0615/redaction-map.json
````

We can attach `rbac-delta.patch` generated by: `git diff --no-prefix main..rbac-change-2026-06-02 > rbac-delta.patch`

marta_s: Quick question — do you need the raw KMS logs (which are noisy) or is key ID + envelope hash + rotation record enough?

auditor_jane: Key IDs + envelope hashes + the KMS request_id + rotation proof are usually sufficient. If you provide a sampling of raw events, redact any plaintext but include request_ids so we can correlate.

raj_patel: To correlate, we used these Splunk queries (will paste in manifest):
`index=k8s_audit user=alice action=patch object=rolebinding | stats count by _time, request_id`
and then join with KMS logs:
`index=kms request_id=... | table _time, request_id, key_id, event_type`
That gives us the mapping from the RBAC change to the KMS envelope ops.

forensics_bot: Automated evidence package created: s3://evidence/INC-2026-0615/package-20260615.tar.gz (expires 7d).
Manifest path: s3://evidence/INC-2026-0615/manifest.yml
Checksums: sha256: 1234abcd5678ef90...

marta_s: @auditor_jane I'll annotate the package with control mappings: "RBAC-change -> SOC2:CC6" and "Audit-logs -> ISO: A.12.4" and include a short chain-of-custody note describing who accessed the package and when. Anything else to close the ask?

auditor_jane: Please include: 1) RBAC diff with commit SHA + CI run link, 2) list of principals with escalate/reconcile perms at the time T, 3) snapshot of the KMS key policy and rotation record, 4) redaction map describing replaced fields. After that we can sign off on this artifact set.

sam_eng: I'll attach RBAC diff, the KMS policy snapshot, and a redaction map (we tokenise UIDs/IPs and include a mapping file). @marta_s I’ll add the exact Splunk queries in the manifest so auditors can rerun if needed.

marta_s: Thanks — uploading package now and will ping when the presigned download links are ready. :thumbsup:
